name: Toho Chemical Industry Company, Limited
summary: Toho Chemical Industry Company, Limited, formed in 1938 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, makes and distributes industrial chemicals, resins, specialty chemicals and surfactants worldwide. Its customers range from cosmetics, toiletries and household cleaners to textiles, pulp and paper, agricultural pesticides and pharmaceuticals, and in electronic materials it supplies fine cleaning solutions, solvents, additives for photocopier toner and chemical agents.
